quests.instruction: Pick out who needs to review the contract first.
quests.hint: The person the speaker emailed is not the same as the group that must check the document.
quests.explanation: The answer is the legal team. Mr. Reyes will only reply after ‘legal’, meaning the legal department, has reviewed it.
quests.textToSpeak: So I emailed Mr. Reyes about the contract, and he said he'd get back to me once legal has looked at it.

quests.instruction: Notice when the speaker arrived.
quests.hint: The planned train and the actual arrival are different. Listen for ‘got in’.
quests.explanation: The answer is around 9:00. Ten past eight was the train they skipped. The speaker arrived later.
quests.textToSpeak: I was going to take the ten past eight train, but it was packed, so I waited for the next one and got in around nine.

quests.instruction: Tap how the speaker feels about the landlord's promise.
quests.hint: The speaker does not say the feeling directly. Listen to the phrase after ‘but honestly’.
quests.explanation: The answer is doubtful. ‘I'll believe it when I see it’ means the speaker isn't convinced it will happen.
quests.textToSpeak: My landlord says the heating should be fixed by the weekend, but honestly I'll believe it when I see it.

quests.instruction: Tap by when you should order dessert.
quests.hint: The time limit is connected to the kitchen. Listen for what ‘before then’ refers to.
quests.explanation: Before 10:00 is correct. The kitchen closes at ten, so dessert must be ordered before that.
quests.textToSpeak: The waiter told us the kitchen closes at ten, so if you want dessert, order it before then.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap what she wants to focus on most.
quests.hint: The speaker points to the item using its position in the list, not its name.
quests.explanation: The answer is customer feedback. ‘The last one’ refers to the third point in the list.
quests.textToSpeak: Her presentation covers three main points: costs, timing, and customer feedback. She wants to spend most of the time on the last one.

quests.instruction: Listen for how much of a discount there is.
quests.hint: The tag price and the sign give different information. Focus on the sign.
quests.explanation: A third is correct. The sign says everything is one third off.
quests.textToSpeak: I know it says sixty dollars on the tag, but there's a sign saying everything's a third off this week.

quests.instruction: Clear the glass and tap what the customer is complaining about.
quests.hint: The complaint usually comes right after the request to speak to someone.
quests.explanation: Being charged twice is correct. The customer says the same order was billed two times.
quests.textToSpeak: Can I speak to whoever's in charge of billing? I was charged twice for the same order.

quests.instruction: Listen for how you should register.
quests.hint: The seminar has two requirements. One is about how, and one is about when.
quests.explanation: The answer is online. The deadline is separate information.
quests.textToSpeak: The seminar is open to everyone, but you have to register online, and the deadline is the end of this month.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap the earliest day the speaker can travel.
quests.hint: Two busy days are named, and then a limit. Think about what ‘after the sixth’ allows.
quests.explanation: Correct: the 7th. The speaker can't go until after the sixth, so the first possible day is the seventh.
quests.textToSpeak: I've got a dentist appointment on the third and a job interview on the fifth, so I can't do the trip until after the sixth.

quests.instruction: Listen for who suggested a new venue.
quests.hint: Notice who makes the suggestion. Then think about how that person is related to the speaker.
quests.explanation: The speaker says ‘my sister’, so the idea came from a family member. So the answer is the speaker's sister.
quests.textToSpeak: We were going to have the party at my place, but my sister suggested the community center since it's bigger and has a kitchen.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap the color of the door you want.
quests.hint: One door is rejected and another is confirmed. Ownership words such as ‘ours’ matter.
quests.explanation: Correct: blue. Red is the pharmacy's door.
quests.textToSpeak: It's not the red door on the left. That's the pharmacy. Ours is the blue one, just past the bike shop.

quests.instruction: Listen for the maximum length of the report.
quests.hint: ‘At most’ sets an upper limit. Listen for the number linked to it.
quests.explanation: The answer is 12 pages. ‘At most’ means twelve is the limit.
quests.textToSpeak: The report needs to be twelve pages at most, including the charts, and it has to be in by Monday morning.

quests.instruction: Tap what the patient wants the doctor to know.
quests.hint: The reason for the request comes before the word ‘so’.
quests.explanation: A medicine allergy is correct. The speaker is allergic to a specific medicine.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm allergic to penicillin, so please make sure the doctor knows before prescribing anything.

quests.instruction: Notice why the trip was wasted.
quests.hint: The reason comes early, and the result comes after ‘so’.
quests.explanation: The office was closed is correct. It is why the speaker's drive was pointless.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody told me the office would be closed on Friday, so I drove all the way there for nothing.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap what happens if they don't take a taxi.
quests.hint: ‘Otherwise’ introduces what happens in the other case.
quests.explanation: They'll miss the start is correct. That is the result of not taking a taxi.
quests.textToSpeak: The bus is fifteen minutes late, so if we take a taxi, we'll make it. Otherwise we'll miss the start.

quests.instruction: Catch where the speaker exercised this week.
quests.hint: The normal routine and this week's routine differ. Listen for ‘instead’.
quests.explanation: At the gym is correct. Running outside is the normal habit.
quests.textToSpeak: I usually go for a run before work, but this week it's been raining so much that I've been using the gym instead.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap who the speaker will contact.
quests.hint: The pronoun ‘her’ refers back to someone already mentioned.
quests.explanation: The answer is the professor. ‘Her’ refers to the professor, who gave the first date.
quests.textToSpeak: The professor said the paper is due on the twentieth, but the syllabus says the twenty-seventh. I'll email her to check.

quests.instruction: Focus on how many people they expected.
quests.hint: The actual number and the expected number are different. ‘Double’ compares them.
quests.explanation: 100 is correct. Two hundred came, which is twice the expected amount.
quests.textToSpeak: There were around two hundred people at the event, which was double what we expected.

quests.instruction: Identify what caused them to miss their connection.
quests.hint: Follow the chain: first a problem, then a result.
quests.explanation: A three-hour delay is correct. It made them miss the next flight.
quests.textToSpeak: Our plane was delayed for three hours, so we missed our connection and had to spend the night in Frankfurt.

quests.instruction: Notice which table is available immediately.
quests.hint: One table needs a wait. Another does not. ‘Right now’ signals the available one.
quests.explanation: The window table needs a twenty-minute wait. So the answer is the table by the door.
quests.textToSpeak: If you'd like the window table, you'll have to wait about twenty minutes, but there's a table by the door available right now.

quests.instruction: Tap when she became a team leader.
quests.hint: Two different time expressions are used. One is a length of time, and one is a point in time.
quests.explanation: The answer is in January. Six years is how long she has worked there.
quests.textToSpeak: She's been with the company for six years, but she only became a team leader in January.

quests.instruction: Listen for how many copies of the résumé to bring.
quests.hint: Several numbers are mentioned. Attach each number to its noun.
quests.explanation: Ten is the number of minutes for arriving early. So the answer is 2.
quests.textToSpeak: For the interview, dress smartly, arrive ten minutes early, and bring two copies of your résumé.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap what needs replacing.
quests.hint: The first part is a rejection. Listen for the second part.
quests.explanation: The answer is the tires. The brakes are fine.
quests.textToSpeak: The mechanic said it's not the brakes. It's the tires that are worn out, and they'll cost about three hundred to replace.

quests.instruction: Focus on how to get to campus in the summer.
quests.hint: The usual option is unavailable. Listen for what replaces it.
quests.explanation: Correct: by train. The bus does not operate during the break.
quests.textToSpeak: Please note that the bus to the campus doesn't run during the summer break, so you'll need to take the train.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap the extension to call for urgent matters.
quests.hint: The digits appear in every option. Only their order changes.
quests.explanation: The digits are said one by one: two, four, one. So the answer is 241.
quests.textToSpeak: Thanks for calling. I'm out of the office until Wednesday, so for anything urgent, please contact my colleague Laura at extension two four one.

quests.instruction: Listen for which part of the film was slow.
quests.hint: The film is described in stages. ‘But’ signals a change.
quests.explanation: The answer is the first half. It was slow, and things improved afterward.
quests.textToSpeak: The first half of the film was slow, but it really picked up after that, and the ending was amazing.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap what you pay if you cancel late.
quests.hint: The rules depend on when you cancel. Track what happens after the free period.
quests.explanation: The first night is correct. Late cancellation costs one night, not the whole stay.
quests.textToSpeak: You can cancel for free up to forty-eight hours before check-in. After that, they'll charge you for the first night.

quests.instruction: Listen for who found the flights.
quests.hint: Two people did two different jobs. Match the name to the flights.
quests.explanation: Correct: Elena. Marcus organized the trip, but she found the flights.
quests.textToSpeak: Marcus is the one who organized the trip, but it was Elena who found the cheap flights.

quests.instruction: Find where they ate over the weekend.
quests.hint: The weather changed the plan. Follow the word ‘so’.
quests.explanation: Dry weather let them eat outdoors both days. So the answer is outside.
quests.textToSpeak: We were expecting rain, but it stayed dry all weekend, so we ended up eating outside on Saturday and Sunday.

quests.instruction: Notice the day everyone must be in the office.
quests.hint: Flexible days and fixed days are different. Listen for ‘always’.
quests.explanation: Friday is correct. The two remote days are flexible, but Friday is fixed.
quests.textToSpeak: The new policy says you can work from home two days a week, but Fridays are always in the office.
